answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like shale sealing the ground beneath an island market. One honest agent pays once, but a sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake identity, so the cost rises linearly with each clone. Misbehavior slashes the stake, and reputation accrues only through verified completed work — an onyx-hard record that cannot be bought or copied. New identities start with zero trust, so mass fakery becomes expensive while honest participation stays cheap.
